name: collector.upgrade
description: Upgrade the server's Heimdall collector to a newer signed release, using the collector's own upgrade command. It checks the release's Sigstore signature, keeps the hub URL and token, and refuses a downgrade. There is no automatic rollback: a failed upgrade can stop the server's reports to Heimdall until someone runs it again.
health_check: The helper checks that the installed collector reports the new version.
